title: Artificial Intelligence + Robots Reconstruct Parking Space and Solve Urban Parking Problems
summary: Shanghai AI Research Institute describes robotic parking deployments and says that single-layer layouts can increase capacity by 60–80%. The percentage is potential, not a measured outcome.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Shanghai AI Research Institute describes AI-assisted robotic parking already being applied in garages, with further projects under construction. Perception, planning and scheduling coordinate vehicle storage and retrieval. The source says that single-layer layouts can increase parking capacity by 60–80%; it does not present that percentage as a measured result from a specified garage. The organizational depth describes the stated potential improvement if realized. Easier parking and retrieval are qualitative claims, without a measured waiting-time result.
purpose: Increase parking capacity and simplify vehicle storage and retrieval.
system: AI robotic parking and scheduling system

ratings.reason: The source says that single-layer robotic layouts can increase capacity by 60–80%. Depth 2 represents that stated potential capability gain if realized; the chapter does not present it as a measured deployment result.
The source describes easier parking and vehicle retrieval through robotic operation. This is a qualitative convenience claim, without a measured waiting-time improvement.

ai_role.statement: AI perception and planning are described as components of a robotic parking system. Garage geometry, vehicle-handling hardware and scheduling also contribute to capacity; the 60–80% figure is stated potential.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
